entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand GPS Tracker. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
Don't give me the runaround! It's just plain hard to use. The whole interface is incredibly confusing. I really expected more from a brand like VeloFit. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration. Sometimes there's a bit of a learning curve. Could you tell me what specific feature you're finding confusing? I might be able to walk you through it.

I'm not a child! I read the user manual and it's useless! I'm not interested in a tutorial, I'm interested in a refund. Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager and plaster bad reviews all over the internet?
Okay, okay, no, that won't be necessary. I can definitely handle this for you. Let me just pull up your order details and review our policy. Can you confirm the order number for me?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand was delivered on January 10th, which was 12 days ago. Let me check the return eligibility... Yes, it looks like our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe.
See? I told you. I knew I was right. So are you sending the shipping label or what?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed.
Fine. That's what you should have done in the first place.
My apologies again for the trouble. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
